summary: A quick tour of your website dashboard and where everything lives.
content:
Your website is built so you can keep the day-to-day details fresh without calling me. Everything you need is in the sidebar on the far left of this screen. It shows icons, and hovering over one shows its name.

## The sidebar

- **Home** is the page you land on when you sign in.
- **Collections** holds your **Menu** and **Specials**. This is where you'll spend most of your time.
- **How-To** is this help area. I wrote everything here for you and your team.

## The three things you'll do most

1. [Change a price](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/change-a-price)
2. [Add a weekly special](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/add-a-weekly-special)
3. [Change a dish's photo](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/change-a-dishs-photo)

## You can't break it

The design and page layouts are out of reach from your account, so nothing you do here can change how the site is built. If you make a typo, open the same item and fix it. Your changes appear on the website as soon as you save.
